prompts.portraits:
Create an edited six-subject TRANSPARENT icon sheet for the existing MMORPG field guide, using the supplied six character concept sheets for identity, and the last approved-study image ONLY for watercolor/ink technique. This is a painterly illustration translation, not a model render. Output exactly 3 columns by 2 rows with generous empty transparent gutters and outer margins, one separated complete subject per cell, no touching, NO labels, text, circles, badges, scenery, ground shadows or background. Even approximately square cells. Use broad subdued watercolor washes, irregular fine umber ink contours, visible hand-painted pigment variation, simplified purposeful marks, stylized anime creature anatomy, strong readable silhouette and eyes at 50px. Not plush/chibi, not photorealistic, not glossy 3D.

Exact ordered cells:
TOP LEFT: Tidal Slime from salt_slime_concept_v2: a compact turquoise curling wave-shaped slime with a white foamy crest, two narrow dark eyes with white glints, three white salt crystals embedded at lower right. Whole wave body, readable face.
TOP MIDDLE: Boarbull from tusk_boar_concept_v2: HEAD and broad heavy chest portrait; rusty orange thick shaggy boar mane, pink pig snout, tan throat/chest, two enormous sideways/upcurving ivory bull horns coming from temples, smaller ivory mouth tusks. Fierce heavy boar identity. Show all horn tips with padding.
TOP RIGHT: Maskfang Wolf from thornback_wolf_concept_v2: HEAD and short neck only, dark charcoal-grey fur, cream angular mask on forehead and cheeks, amber eyes, two small lower-projecting fangs, pointed ears. Moderately shaggy dark neck, no green leaves or thorns. Match exact mask markings, not an unrelated realistic wolf.
BOTTOM LEFT: Greyfang Alpha from greyfang_concept_v2: HEAD and broad neck only, same dark mask wolf family but much larger layered SILVER GREY and CREAM spiked mane around face, amber eyes, prominent two fangs, regal fierce pack leader; visibly broader/lighter mane than normal wolf. No crown, invented horns, green thorns, or viewer buttons from screenshots.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: Reedblade Viper from reed_viper_concept_v4: compact raised head and neck with hint of one coil at base, olive green scales, cream segmented throat, amber eye, dark evergreen sharp REED LEAF crest blades with muted gold edges behind head. Do not add a cobra hood, wings or extra snake; all blades intact.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Lostlight Wisp from marsh_wisp_concept_v2: curling cyan/blue flame body, very dark navy face with two pale cream eyes, LARGE faceted warm GOLDEN crystal in torso embraced by flame. One compact complete flame silhouette, at most two small nearby blue motes. Gold core must be clear, no realistic bloom.

Preserve identities from the exact character references, while painting all six together in the same approved hand-painted field-guide style. Species designs are authoritative; remove text and screenshot UI. Genuine alpha transparency outside painted subjects; retain cream/white foam, fur and eyes as opaque painted details.
prompts.materials:
Create a transparent TWO-ICON materials sheet for this anime MMORPG inventory, adapting ONLY the two missing drop designs from the supplied Reedblade Viper and Lostlight Wisp character sheets. Use the existing-materials sheet as the authoritative inventory illustration style: hand-drawn dark warm contours, simplified painted/cel shading, clear mass, modest highlights, sharp small-size silhouette, no glossy 3D render. These item icons are different from watercolor monster portraits and must match existing inventory items.

Exactly two separated subjects in one row, left and right, similar painted extent, at least 12% clean transparent outer margin and a wide transparent gutter. NO text, labels, borders, checkerboard, backdrop, ground/shadow, glow haze, extra items or duplicated subjects. Genuine alpha transparency.

LEFT icon viper_scale: ONE long pointed leaf-shaped scale from the actual DROP illustration on reed_viper_concept_v4. Diamond/lance reed-leaf silhouette angled up-right, dark evergreen green center with olive facets, a muted golden narrow edge all around, central reed-like ridge. It must read as a flat pointed reed blade, not a bulky crystal. No stem, no sword hilt.

RIGHT icon wisp_core: ONE large faceted warm golden crystal from the actual DROP illustration at lower right of marsh_wisp_concept_v2. Long vertical diamond with clear golden faces and cream highlights, embraced by a few compact cyan/blue curved flame tongues, no face, no eyes. Gold crystal occupies most of the icon. Avoid a full flame-creature portrait. No extra floating crystals, gold motes or dust; one isolated item.

Preserve the exact approved source drop identities while matching the already-approved existing inventory linework and colors. Whole tips and flame curls must fit with padding. Render at high definition; final icons will be cut individually and shown at 32/40px.
prompts.wisp_correction: Edit ONLY the first reference image, the isolated Lostlight Wisp watercolor icon. Preserve the main cyan/blue flame creature, dark face, two pale eyes and its large GOLDEN crystal body core, same pose, silhouette, scale and hand-painted wash/umber ink technique. Fix one visible identity error: the detached flame to the creature's right currently contains a second small golden crystal. Remove that whole gold-containing detached flame. Keep at most TWO small BLUE-only flame motes, no extra golden cores. One golden core only, in the main torso. The actual second reference concept shows small motes as plain cyan flame. Do not invent new objects, eyes, borders or text. No background, ground shadow, gradient halo or rectangular matte. True alpha transparency. Complete main flame curls with generous clean transparent padding. Maintain the simplified hand-painted field-guide style at 50px; do not turn it into a glossy 3D render. Output one isolated revised icon, not a batch or concept sheet.
